items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: So I got in Cafe Society with Ed Hall, stayed with Ed Hall for over three years. ... I had to see because I hadn't played -- I'm coming out of a big band. Now, Ed Hall had a small band, so I had to learn how to do it.

ctx.x: Did you take [many] solos when you were working in Hall's band?
In Ed Hall's -- no, I didn't know how
to. I'd take breaks, but seles --
